name: Question 12
problem:
$$
f(x)∼\frac{{a}_{0}}{2}+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }{a}_{n}\operatorname{cos}⁡(nx)
$$

Let $F(x)=10x$ for $x\in [0,\pi ).$ The Fourier cosine series of the **even** $2\pi $-periodic extension $f(x)$ of $F(x)$ is shown above. Find the expression for ${a}_{n}.$$\,{a}_{n}=$ {{field-1}}
for $n\ge 1$
